comment: posixregex.c regex_match(): MSGTYPE=hide "^He(l|x)\1o" against the welcome "Hello RegexTrial, ...". macOS regcomp() (Apple Libc TRE) reads \1 in an extended regex as the digit 1, so the rule does not match and the welcome shows; glibc reads it as a back-reference and hides the welcome. Recorded on macOS, the judge's host, by .github/workflows/macos-recorder.yml (run 44628090866), because regcomp() and regerror() differ between macOS and glibc (docs/testing.md, "The regex difference").
